title: Lucio AI Legal Research Agent Launches in Open Beta
summary: Lucio AI launches its Legal Research Agent in open beta with 25 free searches. The AI-powered tool helps legal professionals streamline case research.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Lucio AI has officially launched its Legal Research Agent in open beta for legal professionals worldwide.
- The AI-powered tool offers 25 free searches to beta users and specializes in case law and statutory research.
- Legal researchers can access comprehensive case analysis and citation discovery through the beta platform starting today.


Lucio AI has officially released its Legal Research Agent in open beta, bringing AI-powered legal research capabilities to law firms and legal professionals. The platform offers 25 free searches to beta participants, marking a significant entry into the competitive legal technology sector.


## Platform Capabilities and Features


The Legal Research Agent specializes in case law analysis, statutory interpretation, and legal citation discovery. Built on advanced natural language processing, the tool helps legal professionals conduct comprehensive research across jurisdictions and practice areas. Users can input complex legal queries in plain language and receive structured research results with proper citations and case summaries.


The beta version includes features such as jurisdiction-specific search filters, case law relationship mapping, and automated citation verification. Legal researchers can explore precedent connections and identify relevant statutes through an intuitive interface designed specifically for legal workflows.


## Beta Access and Free Search Allocation


Lucio AI is providing 25 free searches to all beta participants during the testing phase. This allocation allows legal professionals to thoroughly evaluate the platform's capabilities across different research scenarios. The company has indicated that feedback from beta users will directly influence feature development and refinement before the full commercial launch.


Registration for the open beta is available through the Lucio AI website, with no credit card required for the initial 25 searches. Legal professionals from various practice areas, including litigation, corporate law, and regulatory compliance, can participate in the beta program.


## Release Date and Availability


The Legal Research Agent was officially launched on October 16, 2026, making it immediately accessible to legal professionals worldwide. The open beta represents Lucio AI's first major product release in the legal technology market, positioning the company alongside established players in AI-assisted legal research.


The platform currently supports research across common law jurisdictions, with plans to expand coverage based on user demand and beta feedback. Lucio AI has not yet announced pricing for post-beta commercial access, though the company has stated that pricing tiers will accommodate solo practitioners through large law firms.


## What This Means


The launch of Lucio AI's Legal Research Agent adds another competitor to the rapidly evolving legal AI landscape. With 25 free searches offered during beta, legal professionals have a risk-free opportunity to evaluate whether AI-powered research tools can meaningfully improve their[workflow](https://emergent.sh/glossary/workflow) efficiency. As law firms increasingly adopt AI technologies, specialized tools like the Legal Research Agent may become standard components of modern legal practice, particularly for time-intensive research tasks that benefit from automated case discovery and citation analysis.
